nodes.title: The daily test-call budget is a workspace cap (budget scope 'test', daily, with a per-call hold): default ₹200 a day and ₹50 held per test call, a deployment default via VP_TEST_BUDGET_DEFAULT_INR for workspaces created there, raised by an owner's approval (cap.raise scope test, card names both amounts), lowered at once; calls reads it through the registry tool test.budget and falls back to its constants without the money module
nodes.rationale: directive.2026-10-24.calling-first-build-all: the owner tests long real calls on staging; a constant ₹200/day allowed about four. Spend is the calls module's recorded test-call cost since IST midnight (unchanged semantics), so the cap resets at IST midnight by construction and the ledger never counts it against real calls
nodes.reverse_if: test calls start reserving through the ledger (then the test cap becomes a real ledger cap with spent tracking), or the owner wants test spend charged to the wallet (open.2026-10-24.test-spend-vs-empty-wallet)

events.what: Money: the daily test budget became a workspace cap (0910): ₹200/₹50 defaults, VP_TEST_BUDGET_DEFAULT_INR deployment default (ops/STAGING.md), owner-approved raises, Billing shows it with each test call's cost; calls reads test.budget (seam proposed to the calls session; ~6-line edit, constants kept as fallback).
